title: Read-only sed checker: pin label termination at '#' with allowed and refused test cases
outcome: src/tests/read_only_sed.rs pins how a label is ended, both when another command follows and when a '#' comment follows: `b x#…`, `:x#…`, `t x#…`, with both allowed and refused cases. The comments name the sed behaviour the checker relies on: GNU ends a label at '#', and BSD folds the rest of the line into the label.
acceptance: Read-only sed checker: pin label termination at '#' with allowed and refused test cases is done
